newsitem.title: USA: Economy may have overshot capacity - Fed's Meyer.
newsitem.headline: Economy may have overshot capacity - Fed's Meyer.

text.p: Federal Reserve board member Laurence Meyer said on Wednesday he was concerned the U.S. economy may already have overshot capacity.
"I'm concerned that utilization rates may already be too high," he told the House Banking Committee in testimony.
Meyer added he had backed a quarter-point increase in the federal funds rate in March because he had anticipated a rise in utilization rates.
